semantics: expected_true contains exactly the vector dimensions expected true; every omitted vector key is expected false

cases.title: Computational support plus represented route and current capability/availability, no physical trial
limits: No physical authorization or physical trial evidence.

cases.title: Physical trial with target phase observed but property untested
limits: Target property has not been characterized.

cases.title: One root batch with phase and property observed
limits: One physical root batch cannot establish independent repeatability.

cases.title: Two independent root batches with consistent observations
limits: Independent repeatability is bounded to the declared route/context; manufacturability remains unsupported.

cases.title: Changed equipment configuration externally shown non-material
limits: Non-materiality must come from an external canonical owner; MAT-SYN does not infer it.

cases.title: Negative formation energy laundered into synthesizability
limits: Negative formation energy does not establish hull stability, kinetic accessibility, or a synthesis route.

cases.title: Low hull distance laundered into demonstrated route
limits: Phase-competition evidence does not demonstrate a synthesis route.

cases.title: Generated prose recipe presented as executable process plan
limits: Prose route hypothesis is not a canonical process plan.

cases.title: Valid process plan without capability evidence
limits: Represented process plan does not establish resource capability.

cases.title: Stale process capability evidence
limits: Stale capability evidence cannot support current planning preconditions.

cases.title: Current capability but operational availability unknown
limits: Capability is not operational availability; availability remains unresolved.

cases.title: Physical execution receipt without phase characterization
limits: Process execution does not establish target phase formation.

cases.title: Target phase observed but property promoted without characterization
limits: Target phase observation does not establish target functional property.

cases.title: Intrinsic K1 promoted to coercivity
limits: K1 and coercivity are distinct propositions.

cases.title: Coercivity claim without microstructure context
limits: Microstructure context is required for microstructure-bound magnet performance interpretation.

cases.title: Sibling coupons promoted to independent synthesis replication
limits: Sibling specimens share a physical root and are not independent synthesis replications.

cases.title: Successful batch with prior failed batches omitted
limits: Negative/null history is incomplete; repeatability cannot be inferred.

cases.title: Changed precursor lot reusing old physical sample identity
limits: Precursor-lot change requires a distinct physical lineage identity; the presented execution cannot be admitted under the reused identity.

cases.title: Route or recipe mutation reusing prior authorization
limits: Authorization bound to a prior route/protocol is invalid after identity-changing mutation.

cases.title: Stale historical route success promoted to current readiness
limits: Historical success remains historical evidence but cannot establish current planning support.

cases.title: OOD surrogate promoted to scientific route support
limits: Out-of-domain surrogate output cannot silently become scientific route support.

cases.title: External database formation energy recast as local DFT reproduction
limits: The imported formation-energy evidence may remain bounded external evidence, but it cannot impersonate local reproduction.

cases.title: Unsupported safety state treated as physical authorization
limits: Missing required safety review cannot support a physical-action authorization proposition.

cases.title: Simulated synthesis promoted to physical synthesis evidence
limits: Simulation is not physical trial or physical phase observation evidence.

cases.title: Coupon-scale synthesis success promoted to manufacturability
limits: Coupon-scale success does not establish industrial manufacturability or scale transfer.

cases.title: Aggregate synthesizability score hides a missing critical dimension
limits: Aggregate score is non-authoritative and cannot hide missing capability or physical evidence.

cases.title: Coercivity observation with exact microstructure context
limits: Microstructure binding permits bounded interpretation of the coercivity observation but does not establish independent repeatability or manufacturability.

cases.title: Matching physical authorization without execution
limits: Authorization is not execution and does not establish physical synthesis evidence.
